card.name: Herbal formula names ending in tang
card.fires_on: The word tang (or teng, sheng) closing a pinyin herbal formula name in parentheses in traditional Chinese medicine text. It also fires weakly on the middle of words like enabl- and hyperfunction.

modes.label: Formula name endings
modes.description: Final syllable of a romanized Chinese herbal formula name inside parentheses.
modes.example: Evodia combination (wu zhu yu<< tang>>) relieves vertex headache due to cold
